edges.source_text: Interest subvention of 3% per annum up to a limit of Rs 2 crore
25% of outlay as back ended capital subsidy for general category, 33.33% for SC/ST
Financial assistance of Rs.18.00 lakh per FPO for a period of 3 years
Interest subvention of 2% and additional 3% prompt repayment incentive
100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year
Unit assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly States
Subsidy of 15-35% of the project cost
The farmer's share of premium is 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
life cover of Rs. 2 Lakhs for death due to any reason at a premium of Rs. 436 per annum
55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers, 45% for other farmers
Rs. 2 Lakh for accidental death and permanent total disability and Rs 1 Lakh for permanent partial disability
Under the scheme an income support of Rs.6000/- per year is provided to all farmer families across the country in three equal installments of Rs.2000/- each every four months.
guaranteed pension of Rs.3000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years
Central Financial Assistance of 30% of the benchmark cost and State subsidy of 30%.
Rs.13,500/- per annum as investment support to every farmer family
